column1: # The reads of the web interface that the collector keeps in the state database (scripts/reads-collect.sh).
# words of the `hs sys` read <TAB> how often, in seconds. A line is the exact read the pages ask for (`pool info bulk` = ?pool=bulk).
# Only reads whose scripts take a moment (smartctl, zpool, incus, samba-tool, curl to the router); `hs sys state reads` shows what is kept and how long
# each took, `hs timing` how long a cold run is. Take a read out when it is cheap, put one in when a page waits for it.
